newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks close slightly lower on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks close slightly lower on profit taking.

text.p: Thai stocks ended slightly down on Monday as some consolidation emerged after the market's recent rally, brokers said.
The composite SET index closed 0.90 points off at 527.28 on 3.46 billion baht turnover. The SET-50 index eased 0.21 to 38.20.
"Profit taking played a major role today. But some buying interest helped bouy the market from making a sharp fall," one broker at United Securities said.
Losers led gainers 183 to 133 and 73 counters closed unchanged.
"The market remained okay. Some foreign investors might be away from the market to watch the Hong Kong handover," the broker said.
Brokers said the market concern about the health of finance firms had eased today after the central bank said early on Monday that there would be no announcement of more new troubled finance firms.

In an effort to bolster stability in the ailing finance industry, the Bank of Thailand on Friday suspended operations of 16 troubled finance companies and forced them to submit merger plans in 14 days.
Thai bourse on Monday also issued a statement early on Monday urging investors not to panic and to be cautious in their analysis and response to the finance sector turmoil.
Krung Thai Bank closed down 0.25 baht at 27.25 on the most active trade of 257 million baht.
Bangkok Bank rose two to 129 and Thai Farmers Bank dipped 3.50 to 79.50.
Mobile phone operator Advanced Info Service gained 12 to 226.
